requirement:
`habeas author <full-name> [--config <name>] [--missing | --force] [--stdout] [-v|--verbose]`
MUST author the evidence of one existing requirement or named example in the
current project, under {cite}`requirements.authoring.refresh`. It MUST report the
selected subject, backend, model, evidence destination, and usage-record path on
completion. The evidence destination MUST identify the evidence-file path by
default or stdout when `--stdout` is selected. In stdout mode, the completion
report and diagnostics MUST go to stderr. `author-evidence` MUST remain an alias
for the single-subject command.
rationale:
The reviewed tests adequately cover `requirements.authoring.invocation`. I did not need to read implementation source.

**Obligations and the tests that check them**

- **Author one existing requirement or named example.**
  - `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[initial_prompt_substitutes_subject_and_mandatory_inputs_into_the_template]` runs `author` for both a requirement and an example. It checks the evidence record: `requirement` is set for one and `example` for the other, and the other field is absent.
  - `fn[author_rejects_unknown_subjects_and_conflicting_targets]` checks that an unknown name fails and names the subject in stderr. It also checks that `<name> --all` is rejected with "cannot be used with" and leaves the evidence file unchanged.
- **Report subject, backend, model, evidence destination and usage path on completion.**
  - `fn[ollama_cli_delivers_sources_records_fixme_and_keeps_usage_content_free]` asserts that stdout starts with `{SUBJECT}: ollama / {MODEL}`. It also checks the `Evidence:` line, whose path canonicalizes to `evidence/{SUBJECT}.json`, and the `Usage:` line.
  - The initial-prompt test repeats the subject/backend/model check for both subject kinds. It also checks that the `Evidence:` path equals the project evidence file and that the `Usage:` path is a file.
- **Evidence destination is the path by default and `stdout` with `--stdout`.** The default case is covered above. `fn[stdout_emits_only_evidence_json_without_changing_project_files]` asserts `Evidence: stdout\n` in stderr.
- **In stdout mode the report and diagnostics go to stderr.** The stdout test parses the whole of stdout as the evidence JSON, so any report or diagnostic text on stdout would fail it. It asserts that stderr holds the `{SUBJECT}: ollama / {MODEL}` line, the `Evidence:` line and the usage path. It runs with and without `--verbose` and for every determination kind. It also checks that project evidence is unchanged, or not created when none existed.
- **`--config <name>`.** `fn[an_explicit_configuration_selects_the_nondefault_workspace_profile]` selects a non-default profile. It asserts that the request used `alternate-model` and that usage records the model and backend.
- **`-v` and `--verbose`.** `fn[verbose_single_author_reports_only_false_rationale_without_source_inputs]` exercises both spellings. The stdout test exercises `--verbose` together with `--stdout`.
- **`author-evidence` alias.** It is used as a real invocation in the ollama CLI test, in the stdout test and in the batch test. The batch test also covers it with a named example.
- **`--missing`/`--force` and `--stdout`, under the cited `requirements.authoring.refresh`.** `tests/authoring_batch.rs#fn[missing_keeps_current_records_and_force_reassesses_every_selected_subject]` covers the single-subject cases:
  - The default and explicit `--missing` skip a current record with no model call, and the report says "1 skipped as current".
  - A bad configuration is not resolved when nothing needs assessment.
  - `--missing --force` and `--stdout --missing` are rejected.
  - `--force` and `--stdout` each reassess and invoke the model.
  - An invalid evidence file is repaired under `--missing`.

**Gaps and open questions:** none established. The `tests/authoring_cli.rs#impl[Fixture]` helpers (`run`, `command`) are reached from the marked tests. No `{fixme}` acknowledgments apply.

text: :::{req} invocation
`habeas author <full-name> [--config <name>] [--missing | --force] [--stdout] [-v|--verbose]`
MUST author the evidence of one existing requirement or named example in the
current project, under {cite}`requirements.authoring.refresh`. It MUST report the
selected subject, backend, model, evidence destination, and usage-record path on
completion. The evidence destination MUST identify the evidence-file path by
default or stdout when `--stdout` is selected. In stdout mode, the completion
report and diagnostics MUST go to stderr. `author-evidence` MUST remain an alias
for the single-subject command.
:::{req} refresh
Every `habeas author` form MUST accept `--missing` and `--force`, which are
mutually exclusive; `--missing` MUST be the default. Under `--missing`, the
command MUST assess only the selected subjects whose evidence is missing, stale,
or invalid, and MUST preserve every current record without invoking a model,
including accepted FIXME judgments and current false judgments; a current false
judgment is reassessed only when its subject or inputs change or `--force` is
given. Under `--force`, the command MUST assess every selected subject. `--stdout`
MUST imply `--force`, because it writes no evidence. The command MUST report the
number of selected subjects it skipped as current. When no assessment is needed,
the command MUST succeed without resolving model configuration or credentials.
